title: Reset Password
content: Users can reset password from Settings > Security. You will need to verify your current password or use your registered email for a recovery link.

title: Refund Policy
content: Refunds are allowed within 7 days of purchase. The item must be in its original condition. To initiate a refund, please contact support at support@example.com.

title: Contact Support
content: Our support team is available 24/7 via email at support@example.com or through the live chat widget on our website.

title: Subscription Plans
content: We offer three plans: Basic ($9/mo), Pro ($29/mo), and Enterprise (Contact us). Basic includes standard features, while Pro adds advanced analytics and priority support.
